pins.definition: A period of time lasting sixty minutes.

situation: A desk worker in a low-rise office building stares up at a wall-mounted digital clock as the minutes click over.
subject: the sixty-minute duration
brief: A glowing digital clock on a drab office wall shows exactly sixty identical minutes being ticked off in sequence across a horizontal strip below the numbers, with a lone office worker watching the final digit flip.
